pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Devadatto pahīnalābhasakkāro sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā kulesu v. v. bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.5: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ, kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto sapariso kulesu v. v. bhuñjissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.9: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Devadatta sapariso kulesu v. v. bhuñjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.12: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa sapariso kulesu v. v. bhuñjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.16: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā gilāne bhikkhū bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā gaṇabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.6: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.9: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvaradānasamaye sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyādetvā bhikkhū nimantenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:3.3: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:3.7: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:3.9: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:3.10: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:4.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvarakārake bhikkhū bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:4.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:4.5: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:4.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:4.8: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū manussehi saddhiṃ addhānaṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.2: atha kho te bhikkhū te manusse etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.6: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā na paṭigaṇhanti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.11: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo addhānagamanasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:5.12: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||5||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū manussehi saddhiṃ nāvāya gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.2: atha kho te bhikkhū te manusse etad avocuṃ: muhuttaṃ āvuso tīraṃ upanetha, piṇḍāya carissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.3: te evam āhaṃsu: idh' eva bhante bhuñjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.7: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.9: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo addhānagamanasamayo nāvābhirūhanasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.10: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||6||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.1: tena kho pana samayena disāsu vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhū Rājagahaṃ āgacchanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.2: manussā nānāverajjake bhikkhū passitvā bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.6: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo . . . nāvābhirūhanasamayo mahāsamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.9: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||7||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa ñāti sālohito ājīvakesu pabbajito hoti. atha kho so ājīvako yena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ etad avoca: icchām' ahaṃ mahārāja sabbapāsaṇḍikabhattaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.2: sace tvaṃ bhante buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.4: atha kho so ājīvako bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi: adhivāsentu me bhikkhū svātanāya bhattan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.5: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.6: atha kho so ājīvako yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so ājīvako bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.7: bhavaṃ pi Gotamo pabbajito ahaṃ pi pabbajito,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.9: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.11: atha kho so ājīvako bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo addhānagamanasamayo nāvābhirūhanasamayo mahāsamayo samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti. ||8||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.2: yattha cattāro bhikkhū pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti, etaṃ gaṇabhojanaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.6: antamaso pādāpi phālitā honti, gilānasamayo 'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.8: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso, atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā, cīvaradānasamayo 'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.12: aḍḍhayojanaṃ gacchissāmīti bhuñjitabbaṃ, gacchantena bhuñjitabbaṃ, āgatena bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.14: nāvaṃ abhirūhissāmīti bhuñjitabbaṃ, ārūḷhena bhuñjitabbaṃ, orūḷhena bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.16: yattha dve tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā yāpenti, catutthe āgate na yāpenti, mahāsamayo 'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.18: yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno bhattaṃ karoti, samaṇabhattasamayo 'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.19: aññatra samayā bhuñjissāmīti paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.2.1: gaṇabhojane gaṇabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.2.2: gaṇabhojane vematiko . . . gaṇabhojane na gaṇabhojanasaññī . . . āpatti pācittiyassa. na
